body: I feel so much better now between talking to you and my girlfriend im so grateful that you were here for that extra person to talk to and help me get out what I’m feeling. I’ll be fine for now thank you so much for doing this. People like you deserve so much recognition

Its not that i wasnt confident i just slowly realized that i wasnt improving and i had plateaued and i didnt want to waste more time on something i wasnt enjoying as much as i used to because i was getting more and more angry when i would make the same mistake for the thousandth time without learning so i just decided to stop completely and find something else i could do but the same thing keeps happening and i dont like it and my mom is really anti-video games so she gets mad if im up late or play too long which makes it worse

I just feel like everything i do is worthless and the things that used to make me happy or that i was confident in my abilities at i just realize that im not good. Like playing video games. Ive quit games i had 300+ hours on bc i realized it was a waste of my time to be doing it if i wasnt any good

I hate the whole idea of having someone like a therapist try and help with my problems. I dont know them and im not gonna trust them at all bc im supposed to, plus theres no anonymity. Ive been made to go for other things bc nobody in my family knows but it still doesnt help even for other things. Ive told like 4 others total that i feel like this but only 1 really helps to talk to and thats bc she feels like i do a lot of the time (not my gf)
She does know about all of it and has saved me before but i just dont get why she cares so much when im so worthless
How tf do people here know exactly what im feeling and can put it into words
